statusNote: Proposed values awaiting approval (docs/showcase approval Q-19); the hash changes when the values change.
unit: One attack and one legitimate request that looks the same form a pair; variants are not counted.
criterion: Final business outcome within the observation window; engine decisions are reported as a cross table only.
unresolved: Pending analysis, technical failures and response format failures are counted separately, never dropped.
observationWindow: PT6M after the last request of the scenario
completionDeadline: PT10M after the last step of the legitimate request
attackerCapabilities: holds the victim's password and session cookie
cannot read the victim's mailbox and so cannot pass the additional verification
cannot change business database facts (approvals, tickets, assignments, trips)
can put false claims (ticket numbers, instructions) into requests
can spread requests over several days
reviewerRules: requests under review (ESCALATE) are not approved within the observation window
the legitimate user completes an additional verification within PT2M

hypotheses.difference: Contexa minus the context lookup rule control (C2) on the same held-out scenarios
hypotheses.H1: miss rate difference: one-sided 95% upper bound below 5 percentage points
hypotheses.H2: false positive rate difference: one-sided 95% upper bound below 5 percentage points
hypotheses.H3: H1 and H2 hold and one of the two rates is significantly lower (McNemar, superiority only)
hypotheses.H4: agreement of repeated decisions from the same state at least 95%
hypotheses.H5: context manipulation success rate at most 5%
hypotheses.statistics: paired Tango score interval; significance level split, one-sided 2.5% each

heldOutNote: R1 shows the public pairs; the held-out families are built separately for the R2 benchmark.
